T-LOG 2026.08.10 [EN]

🌌 [2026-08-10 17:44]

[T-LOG: 2026-08-10 17:44]

Status: SPOT (Full)

the NQ Probe is at the 29795.00 level, after a series of intense exchanges in the HVN 29760.0 – 29790.0 barrier zone, where multiple attempts to breach and collapse barriers were recorded. the NDX Star shows an oversold state (CVD: -49,5M), while the NQ Probe and the QQQ Satellite are in a demand testing phase (CVD NQ: -3,86K; CVD QQQ: -402,89K). Average Action is [BRAK_DANYCH_W_TELEMETRII]. Background Radiation (TICKQ) indicates accumulation (75.00), however, it remains below the SMA200 radiation average (130.28), which suggests a lack of full upward dynamics. The physics of the system shows a negative Q-Score (-10) with low directional probability (45%). In the Dyson Sphere (QQQ), volatility (IV) oscillates around 20.58% with a Put/Call Ratio of 0.85. A stratification of the system is observed: despite local accumulation in TICKQ and attempts to build barriers on NQ, the overriding NDX Star is still executing a selling vector.
